# User — Notifications & devices
{: .no_toc }

Support view of a person's inbox and push devices for investigations.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `NTF-05` |
| **Route** | `/admin/users/:userId/notifications` · deep link `substratal://admin/users/:userId/notifications` |
| **Where** | Administration › Users |
| **Who can use it** | users.list (read), users.manage (delete devices) |
| **Kind** | tab |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (Phase 2) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwViewStack` page |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Inbox | table | Notification: created_at, application/source, category, priority, title, state, push.status, skip_reason | read-only; never mark the user's items read | GtkColumnView .data-table |
| Delivery detail | side panel | deliveries[]: provider, status, attempts, error, sent_at |  | AdwOverlaySplitView |
| Devices | table | Device: app, provider, environment, status, inactive_reason, name, app_version, last_registered_at, last_delivery_at |  | GtkColumnView .data-table |
| Delete device | destructive-button | DELETE /users/{id}/devices/{deviceId} | users.manage; audited (device.deleted) | GtkButton .destructive-action |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES

## For developers

Loads: `GET /users/{id}/notifications?include_inactive=true` · `GET /users/{id}/notifications/{notificationId}` · `GET /users/{id}/devices?include_inactive=true` · `GET /users/{id}/devices/{deviceId}`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
